usedFor: Todoist is where post ideas start, and Postify drafts them when “New Task Created in Project” runs “Create Post”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Create Post” in Postify
bestTemplate.why: An idea added to a Todoist project becomes a post draft, so nothing waits in a to-do list.

watchOut: “Create Post” can publish immediately, so set it to save a draft unless you want that.
